items.name: Centene
items.headline: Raises 2026 EPS guidance after Q3 results
items.catalyst: Q3 revenues were $50,647M versus $49,690M, adjusted diluted EPS $0.58 versus $0.50, and 2026 adjusted EPS guidance is now greater than $5.20, up $0.40.
items.thesis: At-risk membership fell to 25,698,200 from 27,968,100 a year earlier, while the health benefits ratio was 92.7%, unchanged. Guidance rose on a smaller member base.

items.name: Quest Diagnostics
items.headline: Raises 2026 revenue and EPS guidance
items.catalyst: Q3 net revenues were $3,097M versus $2,816M; 2026 adjusted EPS guidance rose to $11.25-$11.35 from $11.05-$11.25.
items.thesis: Reported diluted EPS was $2.78 versus $2.16 and revenue guidance moved to $12.065B-$12.105B from $11.95B-$12.05B.

items.name: Hubbell
items.headline: Raises 2026 adjusted EPS outlook
items.catalyst: Q3 net sales were $1,872.5M versus $1,502.4M and 2026 adjusted diluted EPS guidance is $20.40-$20.60.
items.thesis: Adjusted diluted EPS was $5.91 versus $5.17, and the release says backlog continued to build in the quarter.

items.name: Roper Technologies
items.headline: Lifts full-year adjusted EPS guidance
items.catalyst: Q3 adjusted DEPS was $5.89 versus $5.14; 2026 guidance is $22.35-$22.40 versus $22.15-$22.30 before.
items.thesis: GAAP diluted EPS was $4.88 versus $3.68 on revenue of about $2.17 billion, and Q4 adjusted DEPS is guided at $5.95-$6.00.

items.name: Celestica
items.headline: Raises revenue outlook but cuts free cash flow outlook
items.catalyst: Q3 revenue was $5,829.7M versus $3,194.0M and 2026 revenue outlook is $21.0B (from $20.5B), adjusted EPS $11.55 (from $11.30).
items.thesis: Free cash flow outlook was cut to $460M from $600M, so growth is arriving with a lower cash forecast.

items.name: TransUnion
items.headline: Raises adjusted EPS guidance after Q3
items.catalyst: Q3 revenue was $1,312.5M versus $1,169.5M; 2026 adjusted diluted EPS guidance is $4.81-$4.88 and revenue guidance is $5,131M-$5,162M.
items.thesis: Diluted EPS was $0.81 versus $0.49 and adjusted diluted EPS $1.25 versus $1.10; the release says it is keeping the high end of revenue guidance.

items.name: Boeing
items.headline: Smaller Q3 loss with record backlog
items.catalyst: Q3 revenue was $24,188M versus $23,270M, loss per share $(0.26) versus $(7.14), free cash flow $464M.
items.thesis: Total backlog was $745.4B at Sept. 30, and the release says 737-10 was certified in October with 777-9 first delivery on track for 2027.
